title: Completeness notes list a 'landlord reference' document on file for applicants whose own reference notes say it was declined or is still pending
evidence:
+          "Two documents on file — payslips and landlord reference. The form is populated but thin on corroboration: no bank statements, no character reference, no statement of the saving period.",
+          "The employer reference is on file and contactable. The landlord reference was declined, so no independent verification of the previous tenancy exists. A character reference would cover the period with parents.",
+          "Two documents on file — payslips and landlord reference. The form is otherwise fully populated; bank statements and a personal statement would strengthen the file.",
+          "The employer reference from Kite Software HR is on file and contactable. The landlord reference is outstanding. One of two reference legs is verified; the other is pending.",
+          "Two documents on file — payslips and landlord reference. The form is populated and the personal statement is honest about the arrears, but no documentation of the settled possession order or CCJ status is on file.",
+          "The landlord reference from George Nolan is provided and contactable. The employer reference from Corner Café Group is on file. Both contacts verify; the arrears history is not independently confirmable from the references.",
detail: The 'payslips and landlord reference' enumeration was copy-pasted across tom_parts, sara_parts and grainne_parts. Tom's landlord reference was declined and Sara's is pending, so it cannot be on file; their second document is the employer reference. Gráinne has both references on file, i.e. three documents, not two.
recommended_fix: Rewrite each completeness rationale to name the documents that applicant actually has: Tom and Sara = payslips + employer reference; Gráinne = three documents (payslips, landlord reference, employer reference).

title: liam_parts contradicts itself on the document count: 'One document on file' vs 'the landlord reference as the only other attachment'
evidence:
+          "One document on file — payslips — with the landlord reference as the only other attachment. The form is the thinnest in the demo universe on corroboration.",
+              "1 of 5 categories",
+    insight: "...But only one document beyond the landlord reference — payslips — is on file, and no character reference was provided..."
(demo_store.gleam hunk) +        "...{\"label\":\"Only one document on file\",\"severity\":\"amber\",\"category\":\"application_completeness\"}..."
detail: The rationale says one document yet names a second attachment; the insight says one document BEYOND the landlord reference (two total); the evidence line and the demo_store flag say exactly one. Three different counts ship in the same report.
recommended_fix: Decide whether the landlord reference letter counts as an on-file document, then make the rationale, insight, 'Documents provided' evidence and the demo_store flag all agree (apparently two: payslips + landlord reference).

title: income_sources_for drops the a-aoife and a-marta rows whose stated purpose was matching the client fixtures; no fixture change accompanies the deletion
evidence:
-/// Additional income sources (on top of the primary `monthly_income_cents`)
-/// rendered in the report's Household block. Matches the client fixture
-/// stories so the PDF and the on-screen application detail agree.
-    // Aoife: co-applicant Daniel's employer income is a second source.
-    "a-aoife" -> [
-      GetIncomeSourcesByApplicationRow(
-        id: "inc-aoife-1",
-        source_type: "employment",
-        amount_cents: 240_000,
-        note: "Daniel Murphy - Helix Systems",
-      ),
-    ]
-    // Marta: employment-permit holder with a side income from tutoring.
-        id: "inc-marta-1",
-        source_type: "other",
-        amount_cents: 60_000,
-        note: "Part-time English tutoring (monthly)",
(aoife insight, retained) "Her co-applicant Daniel Murphy, a software engineer at Helix Systems, contributes €2,400 per month"
detail: The deleted rows existed so the PDF's Household block agrees with the on-screen application detail; this diff touches no client fixture. Marta's €600 tutoring now vanishes from the PDF entirely, and Aoife's Household block loses the €2,400 row the new extras still narrate.
recommended_fix: Either restore both income-source rows, or remove the corresponding income sources from the client fixtures in the same change and stop citing Daniel's €2,400 as an on-file entry in aoife_parts.

title: payloads() widened to pub with no caller added anywhere in the diff
detail: The function was private and compiled before, so no external caller existed; the diff adds none — the new test imports pdf_prebake but calls only documents_for. The pub widening is unjustified surface area.
recommended_fix: Revert to `fn payloads()` unless an out-of-module caller is being added in this change; if one is, include it.

title: New import of helpers/leaderboard has no corresponding module added or modified in this diff
detail: The diff's only test-helper change is this import; no client/test/helpers/leaderboard.gleam appears in the diff. If the module does not already exist exposing a pub top_three_ids, the client test target fails to compile.
recommended_fix: Confirm client/test/helpers/leaderboard.gleam exists with a pub top_three_ids/1; if it was authored as part of this work, add the file to the change.

title: competition_ranks tie-sharing branch is never exercised — every test added uses eight distinct scores
evidence:
+        Some(ps), Some(pr) if ps == s -> pr
+  // Scores 86, 78, 74, 63, 58, 47, 34, 22 — all distinct → competition
+  // ranks 1..8 (the old bug put the SCORE here, so no entry was ever <= 3).
detail: The pub port's advertised semantics (1, 2, 3, 4, 4, 6) hinge on the `ps == s` guard and the None-tail branch, but the only tests in the diff assert ranks 1..8 over distinct scores. A regression in tie or pending-rank handling would ship green.
recommended_fix: Add a small direct unit test for competition_ranks, e.g. [Some(50), Some(50), Some(40), None] -> [Some(1), Some(1), Some(3), None].
